Describe what this plugin does and which JDK-Go host modes it works in.

- [ ] Adds or changes only one `plugins/*.json`
- [ ] Uses an exact version already published on npm
- [ ] The plugin has an OSI open-source license
- [ ] Does not fill in `tier` or review results (generated by the market maintainers' policy and automated scans)
- [ ] If native adaptation is needed, the existing JDK-Go protocol is declared and implemented in the package as described in the README

Features found by automated checks don't mean the plugin is malicious. Permissions after installation are decided by the host.
